_what: Defaults for tool:match-rows. fields: what to compare when a request names none, each { left, right, kind: number | date | words | same, compare: same | opposite | absolute (numbers), tolerance (number apart, days apart, or the least share of words), weight, required }. confirm_at: least confidence to count as matched. suggest_at: least confidence to offer at all. clear_lead: how far ahead of the next best a pair must be to be confirmed rather than suggested. alternatives: how many other candidates a suggestion lists. ignore_words: words that never count as shared. id_field: where each row keeps its id.
